# Counters with rules

<!-- Generated by `rake docs` from the primitive registry. Do not edit. -->

## +1/+1

Adds 1 to power and toughness (layer 7c). Any +X/+Y or -X/-Y counter works the same way. If a permanent has both +1/+1 and -1/-1 counters, N of each are removed as a state-based action (N = the smaller count).

Rules: CR 122.1a, CR 122.3, CR 613.4c, CR 704.5q

```json
{
  "add_counters": {
    "counter": "+1/+1",
    "amount": 1,
    "to": "self"
  }
}
```

## -1/-1

Subtracts 1 from power and toughness (layer 7c).

Rules: CR 122.1a, CR 122.3, CR 613.4c, CR 704.5q

```json
{
  "add_counters": {
    "counter": "-1/-1",
    "amount": 1,
    "to": {
      "target": 0
    }
  }
}
```

## finality

If the permanent would be put into a graveyard from the battlefield, it is exiled instead.

Rules: CR 122.1h, CR 614.1a

```json
{
  "enters_with_counters": {
    "counters": {
      "finality": 1
    }
  }
}
```

## keyword

A counter named after a keyword (flying, first_strike, double_strike, deathtouch, haste, hexproof, indestructible, lifelink, menace, reach, trample, vigilance) gives the permanent that keyword (layer 6). Write the keyword itself as the counter name.

Rules: CR 122.1b, CR 613.1f

```json
{
  "add_counters": {
    "counter": "hexproof",
    "amount": 1,
    "to": "self"
  }
}
```

## loyalty

A planeswalker's loyalty; at 0 it is put into its owner's graveyard.

Rules: CR 122.1e, CR 306.5b, CR 704.5i

```json
{
  "add_counters": {
    "counter": "loyalty",
    "amount": 1,
    "to": "self"
  }
}
```

## shield

If the permanent would be destroyed by an effect, instead remove a shield counter. If damage would be dealt to it, prevent it and remove a shield counter (simultaneous damage, such as combat damage, removes only one).

Rules: CR 122.1c, CR 614.1a, CR 615.1a, CR 701.8b

```json
{
  "add_counters": {
    "counter": "shield",
    "amount": 1,
    "to": {
      "target": 0
    }
  }
}
```

## stun

If the permanent would become untapped (untap step or an effect), instead one stun counter is removed from it.

Rules: CR 122.1d, CR 502.3, CR 701.26b

```json
{
  "add_counters": {
    "counter": "stun",
    "amount": 1,
    "to": {
      "target": 0
    }
  }
}
```
